## Ethical Approval and Informed Consent

This study involved no human participants and collected no personal data. The 200 benchmark sentences were coded by members of the research team. Ethics approval and informed consent were therefore not required.

## Data Availability Statement

The code, the model scores, the manually annotated benchmark, and the prompts are available at <https://github.com/clessn/mpsa_beyond_language>. The full texts of the news articles were obtained from the Eureka database under license and cannot be redistributed; the article identifiers needed to retrieve them are provided in the repository.
